name: auto-effort
description: Automatic reasoning effort for the Claude Code main chat: the plugin plans each turn, the model raises or lowers it with set_effort, and a cache check keeps it safe.

floor.title: floor: the lowest effort auto-effort ever sends
floor.description: The lowest reasoning effort the plugin sends: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. A lower level the model asks for is raised to this one. Must not be above ceiling.

ceiling.title: ceiling: the highest effort auto-effort ever sends
ceiling.description: The highest reasoning effort the plugin sends: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. A higher level the model asks for, or an escalation, is lowered to this one. Must not be below floor.

planLevel.title: planLevel: the effort every turn starts at
planLevel.description: The effort the first request of every turn runs at, before the model has said what the work needs: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

planUpshiftPatterns.title: planUpshiftPatterns: prompts that start a turn at xhigh (regular expressions)
planUpshiftPatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched case-insensitively against the prompt. A prompt that matches any entry starts its turn at xhigh instead of planLevel.

planUpshiftChars.title: planUpshiftChars: prompt length that starts a turn at xhigh
planUpshiftChars.description: A prompt longer than this many characters starts its turn at xhigh instead of planLevel.

turnReminder.title: turnReminder: remind the model of its starting effort on every prompt
turnReminder.description: On: each prompt carries one line naming the effort the turn starts at and asking the model to call set_effort in its first response. Off: only the tool's description asks for the call.

escalateAfterFailures.title: escalateAfterFailures: failing test runs in a row that raise the effort one step
escalateAfterFailures.description: After this many failing test runs in a row in one turn the effort rises one step, up to the ceiling, for the requests that follow; the count then starts again. A passing test run sets the count back to 0.

lowerOnPass.title: lowerOnPass: a passing test run undoes the rise of failing ones
lowerOnPass.description: On: the first passing test run after a rise returns the effort to the level the turn had before its failing streak raised it (never below floor), unless the model set a level with set_effort since. Off: the raised level holds until the turn ends.

failurePatterns.title: failurePatterns: what counts as a failing test run (regular expressions)
failurePatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched case-sensitively against the result of a test run (see testCommandPatterns). A test run whose result matches any entry fails; one that matches none passes.

failureTools.title: failureTools: the tools whose calls can be test runs
failureTools.description: One tool name per entry (Bash runs the tests). A call of these tools whose command matches testCommandPatterns is a test run; its result is matched against failurePatterns.

testCommandPatterns.title: testCommandPatterns: which commands are test runs (regular expressions)
testCommandPatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched case-sensitively against the command of a failureTools call. A call whose command matches any entry is a test run and counts as failing or passing; the output of any other command (cat, grep, a build) counts nothing. A run sent to the background counts neither way.

userEffortPins.title: userEffortPins: a /effort change between turns pins the session
userEffortPins.description: On: when you change the effort yourself with /effort, auto-effort stops steering that session until /auto-effort on. Off: it keeps steering whatever you set.

models.title: models: which models auto-effort may steer
models.description: One entry per model, as model=allow, model=probation or model=deny. allow steers it. probation steers it while counting clean effort switches; probationSwitches of them earn allow. deny never touches it. A model without an entry gets unknownModels.

unknownModels.title: unknownModels: what a model without an entry in models gets
unknownModels.description: off leaves it untouched; allow, probation and deny act as in models.

probationSwitches.title: probationSwitches: clean switches a probation model needs
probationSwitches.description: How many effort switches in a row of a probation model must keep the cache (see canaryThreshold) before it counts as allow.

canaryThreshold.title: canaryThreshold: cache read the switched request must keep (0 to 1)
canaryThreshold.description: After an effort change, the switched request must read at least this fraction of the previous request's whole prompt from the prompt cache. Below it the plugin stops changing effort on that model, tells you once, and remembers across sessions until /auto-effort clear.

cacheTtlSeconds.title: cacheTtlSeconds: seconds after which a cache check is skipped
cacheTtlSeconds.description: When more than this many seconds passed between two requests the cache may have expired on its own, so the check judges nothing. 300 fits the five-minute cache; use 3600 with the one-hour cache.

statusLine.title: statusLine: pin the level and its reason to the status area
statusLine.description: On: one line shows the level held, why, and what decided it (plan, model, escalation or pin). Off: nothing is shown.

logFile.title: logFile: the decision log (JSONL)
logFile.description: Where decisions are appended, one JSON row per decision, request and turn, never the prompt text. The session id is inserted before the extension, one file per session; after 1000 rows the next file starts (decisions.<session>.2.jsonl, .3.jsonl, ...). A leading ~ is your home directory. Empty: no log.
